تجتنبوا (form VIII)
# تَجْتَنِبُوا (tajtanibū) /tad͡ʒ.ta.ni.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَنَبَ (ijtanaba)
# تُجْتَنَبُوا (tujtanabū) /tud͡ʒ.ta.na.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَنَبَ (ijtanaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
